items.title: Dollar General (DG) Is Being Sued By 20 States Over Alleged Deceptive Pricing
items.summary: Dollar General (NYSE:DG) is being sued by the FTC and 20 states over alleged deceptive pricing across multiple regions. The complaint accuses the retailer of routinely charging higher prices at checkout than those posted on store shelves. Regulators allege the pricing issues affected millions of mostly low income and rural shoppers who rely on Dollar General stores.
